summary: Independent Q6 audit of codecommit-iam-merge-fence@4e336843 finds a genuine CodeCommit control plane: ccctl/cc-api reach IAM evaluation, quorum/FF merge with leases, deliver/event_id, audit, and webhook outbox through a shared ControlPlane facade, plus a live admin cluster (report/ops-health/access-preview/recover-catalog/webhooks/pipelines). Honest entrypoint-reachable substantive runtime/config LOC is ~3,250–3,510 after discounting mild seeder/JSON and near-dup policy overlap, clearing the large_system_strict >=3,000 floor. PADDING_RISK is MEDIUM (not HIGH): team-fragment near-dupes and seed↔policies overlap inflate counts slightly, but major modules are not clones, wrappers, or unreachable filler.

evidence.observation: Q6 requires independent entrypoint tracing, reachability, module diversity, padding/clone checks, coupling/partial-fix traps, and a ~25% removal test. For large_system_strict, PASS needs >=3,000 substantive reachable LOC and no HIGH toy/padding risk. review_scope_hash must be copied unchanged.
Decision right is whether the solver-visible core is complex, reachable, coupled, non-toy, and non-padded. Complexity Governor / authenticity-validator PASS is not sufficient.
large_system_strict treats 3,000 substantive reachable LOC as a floor; dead/unreachable/filler construction toward that floor is an authenticity defect.
Security/AppSec Python task; artifacts [/app/codecommit]; separate verifier; workdir /app/codecommit. Session CREATION_PROFILE is large_system_strict.

QI2 admin productization verified: platform_report/access_preview/write_report aggregate health, policy inventory, open-PR evaluation, merge readiness, config validation, audit summary, IAM report grids, webhook/pipeline bindings, and active leases—reachable from ccctl report/access-preview and GET /ops/report.
ops-health/recover-catalog path: path existence map, catalog rebuild from bare repos, jsonl compaction—reachable via CLI, not dead scaffolding.

Core authorize path with fixed vs broken Deny-skip / star-resource waiver behavior; explain() used by simulate and access-preview matrices.
Distinct StringEquals/Bool/IpAddress evaluators with deliberate broken vs fixed tables—domain MFA/CIDR/ref matching, not constant True shells on the fixed path.
Merge couples quorum, MergePullRequestByFastForward authorize, prepare_protected_merge (branch protection + ref lease), and gitops FF update; broken path lies about FF.
HTTP surface mirrors CLI for push/PR/approve/merge/deliver/dispatch and exposes /ops/report|/ops/health; broken HTTP merge skips IAM while CLI merge does not—cross-entrypoint partial-fix trap.
Deliver couples binding lookup, tip commit, event_id idempotency journal, and outbox enqueue—multi-component exactly-once path.
gated_authorize wraps IAM eval with audit append on allow and deny (deny dropped when not fixed)—audit coupling is live.
FF/ancestor/linear-history checks plus lease acquire/release via branch_protection and ref_lease—stateful merge fencing.
Public contract lists the same admin CLI verbs and /ops HTTP routes as implemented—operator workflow is specified, not decorative.

evidence.observation: Of 61 cc.* modules, 59 are import-reachable from cc.cli/cc.api.app/cc.server/cc.seed (only empty package markers cc.api/cc.store missed). Combined reachable Python (~2,966 non-comment) plus non-py runtime/config counted by the complexity walker (~539) ≈ 3,505; raw validator substantive_loc=3510. After discounting ~120–140 seed↔policies/*.json overlap and ~66 near-dup team-fragment lines, honest floor still ≈3,250+.
Four team-fragment policies are near-duplicates (~0.70–0.98 normalized similarity)—mild config padding, not a large unreachable code mass.
write_policies embeds statement bodies also present under policies/*.json—double-counts toward raw LOC if both are summed, contributing to MEDIUM padding risk without collapsing the floor.

findings.criterion: QI2 admin cluster and ControlPlane facade are entrypoint-reachable with non-trivial fan-out
findings.why_it_matters: Confirms the claimed productizing of report/ops-health/access-preview/recover-catalog/webhooks/pipelines is real operator surface, not unreachable LOC padding.
findings.regression_risk: Removing admin wiring without replacing equivalent entrypoints would shrink reachable depth and could re-open a padding/reachability challenge.

findings.criterion: Mild padding via near-dup policy fragments and seed↔JSON policy body overlap
findings.why_it_matters: Keeps PADDING_RISK at MEDIUM rather than LOW; does not by itself drop honest reachable LOC under 3,000 or raise risk to HIGH.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional later cleanup: dedupe team-fragment templates or generate policies only from seed without dual-counting bodies—not required to pass Q6 now.
findings.regression_risk: Aggressive deletion of seeded policy variety could weaken IAM coverage scenarios if attachments still reference fragment IDs.

findings.criterion: Cross-module invariants create real partial-fix traps
findings.why_it_matters: Supports non-toy production depth: fixing CLI merge IAM alone fails HTTP merge; fixing deliver idempotency alone can miss outbox enqueue; fixing conditions alone can miss deny-audit.
findings.regression_risk: Collapsing API merge onto CLI ControlPlane without care could accidentally weaken the dual-path defect surface the task intends.

role_output.SUBSTANTIVE_LOC_ASSESSMENT: large_system_strict floor met. Independent count: validator substantive_loc=3510 over task.toml+environment; AST reachability from ccctl/cc-api/seed covers essentially all cc runtime modules (~2,966 non-comment Python) plus ~539 non-py runtime/config lines (~3,505 combined). After discounting ~120–140 LOC of seed.write_policies bodies that duplicate policies/*.json and ~66 LOC of near-duplicate team-fragment-* policies, honest entrypoint-reachable substantive runtime/config remains approximately 3,250–3,350 (>=3,000). Seed bootstrap and admin reporting are counted only where they participate in operator/runtime workflows; catalog/ops JSON is domain config, not opaque filler.

Harden approve quorum without aligning merge authorization and fast-forward semantics
role_output.REMOVAL_TEST: Removing ~25% of solver-visible core (e.g. lease+branch_protection+merge_guard, webhook outbox/dispatch, or IAM condition tables + authz_gateway audit) would eliminate protected-merge fencing, exactly-once deliver→outbox coupling, or MFA/CIDR/deny audit behavior respectively. Removing only admin inventory helpers would shrink ops UX but leave the incident core; removing IAM/merge/deliver/outbox would collapse the scored control-plane behavior. Therefore behavior is not preserved under large deletion—code is not inert padding.
